title: Identify the publisher of the superhero who has the most powers among all v
question: Identify the publisher of the superhero who has the most powers among all villains with green skin.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_015
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.XCL_027 = a.XCL_001
JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Green'
GROUP BY s.XCL_018, p.XCL_015
ORDER BY COUNT(hp.XCL_013) DESC
LIMIT 1
